headline: Coastal Reserve and Zoo Entry Planning
reservation: Entry to Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve is managed via on-site parking fees; no advance permit is needed for hiking. The San Diego Zoo and USS Midway require timed tickets during peak holiday weeks; verify current entry policies on their official websites.

days.title: Red Sandstone Cliffs and Sea Caves
days.start: Suggested: 8:00 AM from La Jolla Shores

stops.name: Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve
stops.detail: Hike the Guy Fleming Trail for views of the rare Torrey Pine and the Pacific coastline.

stops.name: La Jolla Cove
stops.detail: View resident sea lions and seals from the bluffs, keeping the legally required distance from wildlife.

days.driving: Allow 40 minutes; conditions vary with Pacific Coast Highway traffic
days.note: Beach trails at Torrey Pines are inaccessible during high tide; check local tide charts before descending.

days.title: Cultural Oases and Maritime History

stops.name: Balboa Park Botanical Building
stops.detail: Explore one of the world's largest lath structures housing tropical plants and a lily pond.

stops.name: USS Midway Museum
stops.detail: Tour the historic aircraft carrier anchored in San Diego Bay to learn about naval aviation.

days.driving: Allow 20 minutes; conditions vary with downtown congestion
days.note: Balboa Park is vast; use the free internal tram to move between museums and garden complexes.

days.title: Island Sands and Rugged Peninsulas

stops.name: Hotel del Coronado
stops.detail: Walk the sparkling mica-rich sands of Coronado Beach in front of this Victorian landmark.

stops.name: Cabrillo National Monument
stops.detail: Visit the Old Point Loma Lighthouse and explore the tide pools at the tip of the peninsula.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour; conditions vary across the Coronado Bridge
days.note: Point Loma tide pools are best visited at low tide; check the NOAA tide predictions for the San Diego Bay entrance.

intel.title: Coastal Arrival Strategy
intel.text: La Jolla Cove and Shores parking lots typically fill by 10:00 AM on weekends. Arrive early or utilize paid structures in the La Jolla Village to ensure access.

intel.title: Urban Connectivity
intel.text: High-speed cellular signal is consistent throughout the metropolitan area and beaches. Signal may be intermittent in the lower canyons of Mission Trails Regional Park.

intel.title: Metropolitan Refueling
intel.text: Gas stations are abundant throughout the city and near the airport. Prices vary significantly between downtown and the suburban gateway areas like Carlsbad.

intel.title: Marine Layer Awareness
intel.text: May and June often feature 'June Gloom,' where coastal fog persists until afternoon. Plan inland activities like Balboa Park for the morning hours during these months.

intel.title: Wilderness Trail Closures
intel.text: Mission Trails and Torrey Pines may close specific paths after rare heavy rainfall to prevent erosion. Check the official park social media or websites for daily status.

plan.arrival: Arrive at San Diego International (SAN), pick up your rental car, and head to the nearby Little Italy or North Park neighborhoods for local supplies and check-in.
plan.vehicle: Standard sedans are suitable for all major attractions; consider a compact car to make parking in historic districts like the Gaslamp easier.
plan.goldenHour: Sunset Cliffs Boulevard offers an unobstructed view of the Pacific horizon, particularly dramatic during the winter sunset season.
